description: Usuarios Servicio de Acueducto por Mes, Uso y Estrato - Funza Cundinamarca is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Empresa Municipal de Acueducto, Alcantarillado y Aseo de Funza EMAAF ESP, Cundinamarca. Coverage: Empresa Municipal de Acueducto, Alcantarillado y Aseo de Funza EMAAF ESP, Cundinamarca. The portal files it under the publisher Empresa Municipal de Acueducto, Alcantarillado y Aseo de Funza EMAAF ESP, Cundinamarca. Its tags are servicios de acueducto, usuarios de servicios, servicios publicos domiciliarios, acueducto y alcantarillado. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Vivienda, Ciudad y Territorio. The portal shows 2023-11-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
